# n-option

> Selectable option within a listbox or select dropdown.

**Class:** `NOption`

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `value` | `string` | Option value submitted on selection |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disables this option |
| `label` | `string` | Display label (falls back to text content) |

## Events

| Event | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `native:select` | Fired on click with `{ value, label }` detail |

## n-listbox

> Listbox component with single or multiple selection and keyboard navigation.

**Class:** `NListbox`

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disables interaction |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | Enables multi-select mode |
| `virtual-focus` | `boolean` | Uses active attribute instead of roving tabindex (for combobox) |

### Properties

| Property | Type | Readonly | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `virtualFocus` | `boolean` | no |  |
| `value` | `string | null` | yes |  |
| `controller` | `DataListController<DataItem>` | yes |  |
| `listValue` | `unknown` | yes |  |

### Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `getActiveOption()` | `—` | `HTMLElement | null` |

### Events

| Event | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `native:change` | Fired when selection changes with `{ value, label }` detail |
